Ao domingo à noite (hora de Moçambique),: On Sunday night (Mozambique time), if you've had 3 or more Zás that week, we put your Zás together in one image, like a poster of the week, and you get the notification “Your Zás summary of the week is ready”. You can “Share in mimos” (with Friends or just Close friends), “Save” it to your gallery or “Share” it outside the app; you can also discard it. The summary is deleted after a week. For this, your Zás are kept for 7 days just for you (others still only see them for 24 hours) and then deleted for good, photo included. There are only two exceptions: a Zás with a pending report stays until it's decided, and if someone replied to one of your Zás, the photo stays in that chat. The summary is made automatically on our server, without anyone seeing it. Don't want it? In Settings, Privacy, “Zás”, turn off “Save my Zás for the weekly summary”: saved Zás older than 24 hours and any unshared summary are deleted straight away, and there are no more summaries. It's Txillapp's artificial intelligence. Open it with the SuperTxill button in Messages or in Search. In “Chat” you ask where everyone's at, what places and events are nearby, whether any Txilladas are live, or ask for ideas for a plan or a caption; in “People for you” you see people with tastes like yours. It's free, with a limit of answers per day (and a monthly total for the whole app). An answer can take tens of seconds: meanwhile “is thinking…” shows, and you can close the screen and see the answer when you come back.
É onde fica quem deve a quem: as dívidas: It's where you keep track of who owes whom: debts from “I'll owe you”, from rounds and the ones you create with “I owe you one”. Whoever owes taps “I've already paid” (they can add a photo and where it happened: nearby places first, or by name) and it only counts as paid once the other person confirms. The place isn't a check-in: it's the label “at Bar X”. If you're actually there (within 150 m) or one of you checks in with the place's QR code within the same hour, it gets the “✓ they were there” badge. The person owed can also “Forgive”. A gelada paid and confirmed counts towards both people's geleira level (3 points for whoever paid, 2 for whoever received it); requests on their own don't count.

É vídeo ao vivo no Txillapp. Em Criar, e: It's live video on Txillapp. In Create, choose “Txillada”, add a title if you like, choose the type (Public: anyone who can see your profile; For friends: people you follow who follow you back, or only your close friends, the same list as for mimos; Private: anyone who wants to join pays an entry fee in vibes) and tap “Start the Txillada”. Em Clipes, toca em «Montagem mágica» (co: Under Clips, tap “Magic montage” (with at least 2 photos or videos) and choose a mood: the app picks the best moments, frames the people, puts the clips in order and cuts them to the beat of the music. “Another version” makes a new one, and “Fine-tune” moves it to the timeline so you can tweak it as you like. Em Convites tens o teu código, a ligação: In Invites you have your code, your link and a card to share, made on your phone with your name, photo, code and up to 4 public items from your geleira (never alcoholic drinks if you're under 18). Anyone who opens the link sees your name, @, photo and those items, even without an account. When someone signs up with your code, you get a notification. If your email is confirmed and your account is more than 3 days old, the person gets 50 vibes once their account becomes active (they confirm their email, post something or follow 3 people, and come back to Txillapp on another day); you get 50 once they've stuck around for another 7 days. Duplicate accounts, on the same device or with the same disguised email, automated accounts and mass sign-ups don't count, and an account under review by the team only counts after the review. Choose the day (Today, Tomorrow, the following days or “Another day”, on the calendar) and the time, in 15-minute steps: at least 15 minutes ahead and at most 30 days from now. You can have up to 5 scheduled, at least 30 minutes apart. It appears on your profile, in your followers' “Upcoming” row and in the link you share, only to people who could see a Txillada of that type. On the card you see how many people asked to be reminded (not who), you change the title, day and time in “Edit” (the type, price and goal can't change) and cancel with “Cancel the Txillada”: anyone who asked for a reminder is notified. You get a notification 15 minutes before and another at the start time. “Start” becomes active 1 hour before; before that, “Start now” moves the time to now. If you don't start within 2 hours of the scheduled time, it expires.

O Mixar de um TxillGroup com 3 a 5 pesso: The Mixar of a TxillGroup with 3 to 5 people. In the group, tap “Group Mixar”, in the header or in ⋯, to propose it: you join straight away and the others get “proposed a group Mixar”, with “Join” and “Not now”. It starts once 3 have joined, including you, and fits up to 5. Only those who join see the feed, the chat, Saved and the challenge, and only the tastes of those who joined count. The selection only includes what everyone can see, and each item says whose taste it matches (“to Ana and Zeca's taste”, “to everyone's taste”). Reactions, seen marks and each item's chat are only between those taking part. A post goes to Saved automatically when the majority react (at least 2). In the Mixa Challenge you see who has already picked and, at the end, how many picked each option, without knowing who picked what. “Send” on an item puts it in the group chat. It doesn't have the weekly summary or “is watching with you”. Your groups' Mixars are also in “My Mixar”.
Os vossos últimos 7 dias: o que mais vos: Your last 7 days: what got you reacting most, your matches in the Mixa Challenge, your streak, the videos watched and the week's topics. It opens from the calendar at the top of the Mixar, and on Mondays it appears at the end of the selection. You can share it as an image in Zás or in mimos: the image includes both your first names, the streak, the matches, the videos watched and the topics, never the video itself or private topics. Either of you can share it, so agree on it with the other person. The group Mixar has no weekly summary.
Que a outra pessoa tem o Mixar aberto ag: That the other person has the Mixar open right now. It appears below the header, with “In the same video as you” or “In another video” (tap to go there), and “is here” on the video they're on. Their reactions appear in real time. They see the same about you, even with “Show when I am online” turned off. It disappears shortly after one of you leaves.
